definitions: To gradually pay off a debt or loan over a period of time.
To write off the cost of an asset over its useful life.
examples: The company will amortize the loan over ten years.
We need to amortize the cost of the new equipment.
They decided to amortize the patent over its legal life.
pastTenses: amortized (simple past), amortized (present perfect), amortized (past perfect)
